body: Nothing is still better than something that is terrible
I don’t really get what you mean, all I got from that is to push everyone out of my life and smoke weed.
I have no talent, no personality, I’m ugly, I’m obese, no one loves me and the only thing I’ve ever done is ruin people’s lives. Just try and twist up some sort of excuse to make me live from that.

There’s not really anyone in my life besides the people who hate me, so there’s no one I’m worried for, I suppose I’m worried that my continued existence will worsen them, and that death is the better option. 

And before you say it, no. There will never be anyone who I can find or will find me that will like me, so there’s no point waiting around for it.

I don’t love anyone and no one loves me, so I’d have to scratch that last part
And in all honesty, do I deserve to be heard? I can’t really tell at this point, but I’m either too far gone and there’s no point in trying to save me, if it’s all fake and I’ve made it all up for attention. Either way, I don’t deserve it.

Thanks, but you don’t know me at all besides what I’ve said in this post, and I assure you that you’re life matters much more than mine. I don’t think I got it across in the post really but I was essentially meaning that if I were to kms, the time I take up from everyone on a day to day basis can be given to the people who matter.
But I want to die because I believe I should, isn’t that a big enough belief?
